evidence: Has the Docs label and exclusively updates the command-line usage help text for `-ipcbind` in `src/init.cpp`.
rationale: Clarifies non-obvious configuration syntax for default Unix socket paths in `-ipcbind`. Users configuring IPC options such as `max-connections` without a custom path lacked guidance that a trailing colon is required (`unix:,max-connections=8`), resolving issue #36657.
